used_additions.sentence: Not everyone with sepsis has every sign, so trust your instincts.
used_additions.evidence: NHS notes not everyone has every symptom and to trust your instincts.

used_additions.sentence: A rash that does not fade under a glass is rare in sepsis, but it can be a sign of meningitis, so call 999 or go to A&E.
used_additions.evidence: NHS: this type of rash is rare in sepsis but may be a symptom of meningitis; listed under call 999 or go to A&E.

used_additions.sentence: In adults, a very high or very low temperature can also be a sign.
used_additions.evidence: NHS lists a very high or low temperature among signs.

used_additions.sentence: People with diabetes and people who have recently had surgery are also more likely to develop sepsis.
used_additions.evidence: Search summary of NHS risk page: diabetes and recent surgery listed.

used_additions.sentence: Sometimes surgery is needed to remove the source of infection.
used_additions.evidence: Search summary: surgery may be needed to remove the source of infection.

used_additions.sentence: Post-sepsis syndrome can also cause problems with memory or concentration, and support such as physiotherapy or counselling may help.
used_additions.evidence: Trust page: PSS can cause memory or concentration problems; treatment focuses on symptoms, may include physiotherapy and counselling.
